UPDATE incident
               SET last_alert_at = greatest(last_alert_at, $3),
                   state         = 'open',
                   quiet_at      = NULL,
                   severity      = CASE
                       WHEN $4 = 'critical' THEN 'critical'
                       WHEN $4 = 'warning' AND severity = 'info' THEN 'warning'
                       ELSE severity
                   END
             WHERE id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2
